regular.automationDescription: Let your Head Coach maintain a rolling three-day training plan. You keep full manual control through Team Defaults and Rider Overrides below.

regular.selectedByCoach: Selected automatically by the Head Coach.

coach.enabledTitle: What happens when automation is enabled
coach.enabledText: The Head Coach privately prepares a rolling plan for Today, Tomorrow and Day +2. The separate forecast table is intentionally not shown to managers. Today's selected focus and intensity appear in the normal Rider Overrides section and in the rider profile training area.
coach.workflowText: Continue using the existing Rider Overrides controls or the rider profile. When Head Coach automation is active, saving a rider change creates an override for the current game day only. The coach automatically resumes control on the next game day.
coach.rollingText: After every game day, Tomorrow becomes Today and a new Day +2 is added. The plan is recalculated after fatigue, health, morale, races, training camps and staff availability are updated.
coach.trainingQuality: Training controls focus selection and session precision.
coach.recoveryQuality: Recovery Planning controls fatigue-aware intensity and rest decisions.
coach.youthQuality: Youth Development improves planning for riders aged 23 or younger.
coach.experienceQuality: Experience and Leadership improve role awareness, consistency and calendar planning.
coach.safetyText: Races, active camps, existing daily activity, injuries, sickness and training-blocking medical cases take priority. A coach on a course or another assignment may have reduced or zero availability.
coach.disabledText: The existing Team Defaults and persistent Rider Overrides control regular training exactly as before.

tutorial.welcomeBody: We can show you how regular training and training camps work, and how they affect rider development, fatigue, and race preparation.
tutorial.regularBody:
This is the Training page.

In Regular Training, you can control what your riders train when they are not assigned to another activity such as a race or training camp.

You can set team default training for the First Team and Developing Team, and you can also adjust training for individual riders. Each rider can train a specific focus such as sprint, climbing, flat, time trial, endurance, resistance, race IQ, teamwork, or recovery.

Training intensity matters. Harder training can improve riders faster, but it can also make them more tired before upcoming races. You can also choose Day Off when a rider needs rest and fatigue recovery.
tutorial.campsBody:
Training Camps are special blocks of training where you send selected riders away for several days.

A training camp can give stronger skill development than regular daily training, but it costs much more. You choose the camp type, location, dates, duration, riders, and available staff.

Staff can improve the effect of the camp or help protect riders better, depending on their skills and availability. Before booking, you can review the cost, weather risk, selected riders, selected staff, and validation warnings.

After Training, the next recommended page is Equipment.
